info.title: Rendex Rendering API
info.description:
Render any webpage, raw HTML, or Markdown to a pixel-perfect image or PDF.
A rendering API for automation builders and AI agents — HTML-to-image, URL
screenshots, hosted OG links, and URL-to-Markdown extraction from one endpoint.

Deployed on Cloudflare's global edge (300+ locations, zero cold starts).
MCP-compatible for AI agent workflows. Free tier included.

**Features**: PNG/JPEG/WebP/PDF output, HTML/URL/Markdown input, batch capture (up to 500 URLs),
geo-targeted rendering (50+ countries), async pipeline with webhook
delivery, CSS/JS injection, custom cookies and headers, full-page capture,
dark mode emulation, ad blocking, element selectors, custom viewports
(320–3840px), device scale factor (1–3x), progressive navigation with
automatic fallback.

get.description: Returns the screenshot as a binary image. Supports `` embedding and browser-based access. All POST parameters are accepted as query params. Accepts API key via `Authorization: Bearer`, `x-api-key` header, or `?key=` query param.

post.description:
Accepts a JSON body with capture parameters. Returns the screenshot as a
binary image with metadata in response headers (`x-screenshot-*`, `x-rendex-*`).

Same capture parameters as `POST /v1/screenshot`, but returns the image
as a base64-encoded string inside a JSON envelope with full metadata.

Submit up to 500 URLs for capture in a single request. Each URL is processed
asynchronously. Returns a `batchId` that can be polled via `GET /v1/batches/{batchId}`.
Shared defaults apply to all URLs unless overridden per-item.

get.description:
Returns the current status of an async screenshot job. When status is `completed`,
the response includes the image URL or base64 data.

Returns the current status of a batch capture request, including per-URL
job statuses and progress.
Returns 200 if the API worker is running.
Verifies connectivity to all external dependencies (database, billing).

post.description: Returns a self-contained, signed URL you can paste straight into `` (or an ``). No backend or storage on your side: `GET /v1/render` renders it on the first request, caches the result in R2 under a deterministic key, and serves the cached copy on every repeat — so a widely-shared link costs one render, not one per crawl. The link encodes the (signed, tamper-proof) render params, the owning account, and an expiry. Credits are charged to the link owner on each cache-miss render only.

expiresIn.description: Link validity in seconds (3600–2592000). Defaults to cacheTtl or 30 days.

url.description: The signed render URL to embed

400.description: Invalid parameters (async/webhook/extract/geo are not valid on a render link)

413.description: Minted render-link URL exceeds the size cap (PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE).

get.description:
Public endpoint — the HMAC signature in the URL is the auth boundary (no
API key). Renders on the first hit and returns the image/PDF bytes;
subsequent hits serve the cached copy. Normally you don't call this
directly — embed the URL returned by `POST /v1/render/link`. The
`x-rendex-cache` response header is `hit` or `miss`.

post.summary: Extract clean content from a URL
post.description:
Turns a single URL into clean reader-mode content — Markdown, JSON, or
article HTML — pulled from the fully-rendered page (so it works on
JavaScript-heavy sites). Text only; for image + text in one call use
`POST /v1/screenshot/json` with `extract: true`.

413.description: Extracted content exceeds the size cap

422.description: No article-like content found to extract

get.summary: Get plan, usage, and upgrade info
get.description:
Returns the authenticated account's plan, this month's usage
(used / limit / remaining and the reset date), the per-minute rate limit,
and a recommended upgrade with a one-tap link. Read-only and free — it
does not consume credits.

post.summary: Render a branded PDF + PNG artifact from Markdown or HTML
post.description:
One call that turns Markdown or HTML plus a small branding theme into a
branded PDF, a PNG, and a hosted share page — built for AI agents and
ChatGPT apps that produce a finished document and need a downloadable,
shareable result. Pass the document body in `content` (Markdown by
default, or set `inputFormat: html`), an optional `branding` theme
(logo, accent color, font, header, footer), and an optional `pageSetup`
(paper size, orientation, margins, scale, viewport). Choose the output
`formats` — `pdf`, `png`, or both. Each requested format charges 1
credit from the same shared pool as the rendering endpoints, drawn with
the same `rdx_` key; the full charge is refunded on a render failure.
The response returns short-lived signed URLs for each rendered format
plus a `shareUrl` to a hosted preview page; all expire after `expiresIn`
seconds (default 24h).

content.description: The Markdown or HTML body to render. Up to ~4MB.

inputFormat.description: How to interpret `content`. 'markdown' is converted to styled HTML; 'html' is used as a body fragment.

formats.description: Which artifact formats to produce. Each format charges 1 credit.

branding.description: Optional theme applied to the artifact header, body, and footer.

logo.description: Absolute http(s) URL of a logo image shown in the header.

accentColor.description: CSS color for the accent bar

font.description: CSS font-family stack applied to the body (e.g. 'Georgia

header.description: Plain-text header line shown beside the logo.

footer.description: Plain-text footer line shown at the bottom of every page.

pageSetup.description: Optional paper/viewport setup for the PDF and PNG.

margin.description: PDF page margins as CSS values (e.g. '1cm', '24px').

width.description: PNG viewport width in px. Default 1280.

height.description: PNG viewport height in px. Default 800.

fullPage.description: Capture the full scrollable page for the PNG. Default true.

data.description: Optional Mustache data. When present, `content` is rendered as a logic-less Mustache template (plus the branding fields) before conversion.

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the hosted URLs expire (3600–2592000). Default 86400 (24h).

pdfUrl.description: Signed URL of the rendered PDF (present when 'pdf' was requested).

pngUrl.description: Signed URL of the rendered PNG (present when 'png' was requested).

shareUrl.description: Signed URL of a hosted share page previewing the artifact.

post.description:
Start monitoring a URL for changes. Rendex renders the page in real Chrome on your
schedule, runs a before/after visual diff (and/or a text diff), and alerts you over a
webhook and/or email when it changes. An active watch captures its baseline immediately,
drawing 1 credit from your shared pool; a failed check is refunded. The same `rdx_` key
and credit pool as the rendering endpoints.

201.description: Watch created (baseline run enqueued when active)

400.description: Invalid parameters, SSRF/Safe-Browsing block, or an incompatible combination (pdf + a visual diffMode, or geo + a text diffMode)

403.description:
Plan wall — watch cap (WATCH_LIMIT_REACHED; counts active + paused watches),
per-host cap (WATCH_HOST_LIMIT_REACHED), interval floor (WATCH_INTERVAL_TOO_FAST),
or a paid-only channel (webhook = Starter+, AI summary & geo = Pro+).

error.message: You have 1/1 watches on the free plan (active + paused). Upgrade to starter for up to 10 watches.

429.description: Monthly credit pool exhausted (hard cap, no overage)

get.description: List your watches, newest first. Filter by state and page with the cursor.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response's nextCursor

200.description: A page of watches, newest first

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor to fetch the next page; absent on the last page

get.description: Fetch a single watch by id, including its current status and configuration.

404.description: Watch not found (or not owned by the caller) — WATCH_NOT_FOUND

patch.summary: Update, pause, resume, or re-point a watch
patch.description:
All fields optional. Set `paused` true to pause or false to resume. `webhookUrl` and
`notifyEmail` accept `null` to switch a channel off.

**renderParams is MERGED, not replaced.** A partial `renderParams` is deep-merged over the
watch's existing render config, so you can change one knob (e.g. `{ "renderParams": { "darkMode": true } }`)
without re-sending the whole object. To clear a knob, set it to its default explicitly.

**Re-baselining.** Changing `url` clears the baseline so the next run re-baselines. A
renderParams edit that changes WHAT is captured (a scope change — e.g. `selector`,
`fullPage`, `width`/`height`, or `device`) likewise invalidates the baseline and
re-baselines on the next run; a noise-only edit (e.g. `threshold`, `ignoreRegions`) does not.

403.description: Plan wall (resume re-checks the caps; a faster interval or the webhook channel may be gated)

delete.summary: Delete a watch and its run history
delete.description: Permanently delete a watch. Run rows cascade; stored images age out via the bucket lifecycle.

204.description: Deleted (run rows cascade; stored images age out via the bucket lifecycle)

get.description: Newest first. Each run carries short-lived signed before/after/overlay image URLs.

200.description: A page of runs, newest first

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor to fetch the next page; absent on the last page

post.description: Enqueue an immediate check (draws 1 credit). The watch must be active.

404.description: Watch not found (or not owned by the caller) — WATCH_NOT_FOUND

409.description: Watch is paused — resume it before running (WATCH_PAUSED)

429.description: Monthly credit pool exhausted (hard cap, no overage)

post.description: Render a proposed watch config exactly as a live check would (same self-identifying User-Agent, SSRF checks, geo + compatibility-mode behaviour, and block/error detection) and return what was captured — so you can validate a selector, scope, or fetch identity and confirm the page is reachable BEFORE committing to a schedule. Creates nothing (no watch, baseline, diff, or alerts). Draws 1 credit; refunded when the page can't be read. A blocked or errored page is a 200 result with reachable:false + an actionable reason, not an API error.

200.description: Render result (reachable or not — both are valid test outcomes)

400.description: Invalid config, SSRF-blocked URL, or unsafe URL

403.description:
Paid-only feature on a free plan — the dry-run applies the same paid-feature gate as
create (but NO watch-count/interval walls, since a test creates nothing). Today only
URL-embedded credentials (`user:pass@host`) bite here: free plans get PLAN_UPGRADE_REQUIRED.

error.message: URL-embedded credentials (user:pass@host) require a paid plan (Starter, Pro, or Enterprise).

ScreenshotRequest.description:
Provide exactly one of `url`, `html`, or `markdown` (mutually exclusive). If none is
provided, the request will fail with a validation error.

url.description: Webpage URL to capture (mutually exclusive with `html` and `markdown`)

html.description: Raw HTML to render (up to 5 MB, mutually exclusive with `url` and `markdown`)

markdown.description: Markdown to render as styled HTML, then capture (up to 5 MB, mutually exclusive with `url` and `html`)

data.description:
Mustache template data object. When present, the `html` or `markdown` string is
treated as a logic-less Mustache template and rendered against `data` before capture.
Valid only with `html` or `markdown` — returns 400 if combined with `url`.
Serialized size must not exceed 256 KB.
Syntax: `{{var}}` (HTML-escaped), `{{{var}}}` (raw), `{{#items}}…{{/items}}` (loop),
`{{^x}}…{{/x}}` (inverted section), `{{a.b}}` (nested access).

fullPage.description: Capture full scrollable page (capped at 16384px height)

delay.description: Wait milliseconds after page load before capture

blockAds.description: Block ads, trackers, and chat widgets

blockResourceTypes.description: Resource types to block during page load

css.description: CSS to inject into the page before capture

js.description: JavaScript to execute on the page before capture

cookies.description: Cookies to set before navigating to the page

headers.description: Custom HTTP headers to send with the page request

waitForSelector.description: CSS selector to wait for before capture

bestAttempt.description: Return partial screenshot on timeout instead of failing

selector.description: CSS selector of element to capture instead of full page

pdfFormat.description: Paper size for PDF output (only applies when `format` is `pdf`)

pdfLandscape.description: Use landscape orientation for PDF output

pdfPrintBackground.description: Include background colors and images in PDF output

pdfScale.description: Scale factor for PDF rendering (0.1 to 2)

pdfMargin.description: Page margins for PDF output (CSS units, e.g. "1cm", "0.5in")

geo.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for geo-targeted rendering (Pro/Enterprise)

geoState.description: State or region for geo-targeted rendering (Pro/Enterprise)

async.description: Process the capture asynchronously (returns a `jobId` to poll)

webhookUrl.description: URL to receive a webhook notification when the capture completes (Starter+ channel; Free/Basic poll GET /v1/jobs/{jobId} instead).

cacheTtl.description: Cache time-to-live in seconds (1 hour to 30 days)

device.description: Device preset — sets viewport, device scale, and user agent in one parameter. Explicit width/height/userAgent still win.

hideSelectors.description: CSS selectors to hide before capture (popups, sticky nav, chat bubbles). Never errors on a miss.

blockCookieBanners.description: Hide common cookie/consent walls (OneTrust, Cookiebot, Quantcast, …) via a curated CSS list.

hosted.description: Store the result in R2 and return `{url, expiresAt}` (a signed CDN-backed URL) instead of the image bytes. Drop the URL into an ``/`og:image`.

extract.description: Also return clean reader-mode content from the same render pass (use on `/v1/screenshot/json`; the binary endpoint rejects it). Shape set by `extractFormat`.

extractFormat.description: Shape of the extracted content when `extract` is true.

resizeWidth.description: Downscale the output to this width (image formats only). Aspect ratio preserved when only one dimension is set. Never upscales.

resizeHeight.description: Downscale the output to this height (image formats only).

urls.description: List of URLs to capture (each item can override defaults)

webhookUrl.description: URL to receive a webhook notification when the batch completes (Starter+ channel; Free/Basic poll GET /v1/batches/{batchId} instead).

totalUrls.description: Number of URLs in the batch

imageUrl.description: Signed URL to the captured image (available when completed)

WatchRenderParams.description:
Render knobs applied on every check — a subset of the screenshot capture params, stored on
the watch and fed to the renderer each run. Inline source params (`url`/`html`/`markdown`/
`data`) and credential knobs (`cookies`/`headers`/`css`/`js`) are NOT accepted here; the
watch's target is the top-level `url`. Validated with a STRICT schema: any capture param
outside the list below (e.g. `quality`, `css`, `js`, `resize*`, `pdf*`, `userAgent`,
`cookies`, `headers`) is REJECTED with a 400 VALIDATION_ERROR — extras are NOT silently ignored.

format.description: A pdf cannot be visually diffed — pair it with diffMode `text`.

fullPage.description:
Defaults to true for watches (overrides the screenshot default of false) so the whole
page is monitored — a viewport-only capture would miss changes below the fold. Set false
(or use a selector) to scope down on purpose.

delay.description: Extra wait in milliseconds after the page is ready

geo.description: Pro+ — 2-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. `US`, `GB`; case-insensitive, upper-cased server-side) to render from. Cannot be combined with a text diffMode.

selector.description:
Capture and diff ONLY this CSS element — watch just one price, banner, or section
instead of the whole page. Visual-first (in text mode the extracted text is full-page).

ignoreRegions.description:
Pixel rectangles masked in BOTH captures before the visual diff — silence dynamic zones
(an ad slot, a clock) so they never trip a change. Visual mode only.

ignoreText.description:
Substrings or `/regex/flags` patterns stripped from BOTH texts before the text diff —
silence boilerplate (timestamps, view counts, session tokens). Applies to text/both modes.

minTextChars.description:
Minimum added + removed characters for a text change to count — ignore tiny edits below
the size you care about.

suppressWhilePresent.description:
While the page text contains any of these markers (e.g. "Out of stock", "Loading"), the
run is treated as unchanged — no alert, no baseline drift — until the marker clears.

uaMode.description:
How the monitor presents its User-Agent. `auto` (default) identifies as RendexWatch and
retries once with a standard browser identity if the page looks blocked; `identify`
always identifies as RendexWatch and never falls back; `stealth` always presents a
standard browser identity. See https://rendex.dev/bot.

CreateWatchRequest.description:
Validated with a STRICT schema — any field outside the list below is REJECTED with a
400 VALIDATION_ERROR, not silently ignored. Render knobs go under `renderParams` (also strict).

intervalMinutes.description:
Check frequency in minutes. The accepted minimum is your plan's floor — Free 1440
(daily), Starter 180 (3h), Pro 30, Enterprise 5. A faster value returns 403
WATCH_INTERVAL_TOO_FAST.

diffMode.description: How changes are detected. Default `both` = a pixel diff (with a highlighted overlay) AND a full-page text diff, alerting on either — catches any change, visual or text. `visual` or `text` narrow to a single signal. (`text`/`both` extract the full visible page text, not just the article body.)

threshold.description: Visual sensitivity (0..1). Low (default 0.01) alerts on ANY change, including a small one on a long page (a changed-region test, not a whole-page pixel ratio). `0.06`+ = only MAJOR visual changes (whole-page ratio). Does not affect text detection.

aiSummary.description: Pro+ — opt in to an AI-written one-sentence "what changed" summary on each detected change. Off by default. Every change already gets a free templated summary regardless of this flag; enabling it upgrades a text change's summary to a Workers-AI sentence.

webhookUrl.description: Starter+ — HMAC-signed change-webhook target. Delivered payload: the WatchWebhookEvent schema.

notifyEmail.description: Any plan — send change alerts here (defaults to your account email if omitted). Anti-abuse: must be your OWN account email; any other address is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

paused.description: Create the watch paused (no baseline capture or charge until resumed). Paused watches still count toward your plan's watch limit.

UpdateWatchRequest.description:
All fields optional. `webhookUrl` and `notifyEmail` additionally accept `null` to clear a
channel. Set `paused` true to pause, false to resume. Validated with a STRICT schema — any
unknown field is REJECTED with a 400 VALIDATION_ERROR, not silently ignored.

`renderParams` is MERGED over the watch's existing render config: send only the knobs you
want to change. A scope-changing renderParams edit (e.g. `selector`, `fullPage`,
`width`/`height`, `device`) re-baselines on the next run, the same way a `url` change does.

Watch.description: A monitoring configuration. webhookUrl is redacted to its host on read.

webhookUrl.description: Redacted to host; null when no webhook channel

baselineImageUrl.description: Short-lived signed URL of the watch's current baseline — the "before" image used in the next change comparison; null until a baseline exists

uaBlockedAt.description: When the target last blocked the RendexWatch identity; null if never

lastChange.description: The "what changed" enrichment from this watch's most recent CHANGED run — returned on GET /v1/watches and GET /v1/watches/{id} so a polling "changed" trigger gets the detail inline (no follow-up call to /:id/runs). Null when the watch has never changed.

aiSummary.description: One-sentence "what changed" summary (templated by default; AI-written when a Pro+ watch opted in)

textDiff.description: Parsed text diff: { added, removed, summary }. Null for a visual-only change

WatchChangedRegion.description: Normalized (0..1) union bounding box of all changed regions on the page — the "where" of a visual change. Multiply by the capture's dimensions to get pixels; use it to crop or annotate in your own tooling.

x.description: Left edge as a fraction of page width (0..1).

y.description: Top edge as a fraction of page height (0..1).

width.description: Width as a fraction of page width (0..1).

height.description: Height as a fraction of page height (0..1).

WatchRun.description: One execution of a watch. Image URLs are short-lived signed links and may 404 for runs older than the bucket lifecycle.

diffScore.description: 0..1 fraction of the page that changed; null for text-only or failed runs

cropUrl.description: Signed image cropped tight to the change ("what changed") — post straight into Slack/a ticket. Null when the run had no discrete visual region (dimensions-only or text-only change).

changedRegion.description: Normalized (0..1) union box of the changed regions. Null when there is no discrete region.

aiSummary.description: One-line plain-English "what changed" summary (Pro+; AI from the text diff, or a templated line from the changed region for visual-only changes). Same value the watch.changed webhook `summary` field carries. Null when unavailable.

textDiff.description: Present for text/both runs; null otherwise

creditsCharged.description: Net credits charged for this run (0 after a refund or for the demo account)

error.description: Free-text failure reason when status is failed

errorCode.description: Structured failure reason; null until/unless the run fails. Branch on this instead of parsing error.

ok.description: True when the page was rendered.

reachable.description: True when the page could be read (not blocked/errored).

httpStatus.description: Navigated page HTTP status (URL mode; null for geo).

usedGeo.description: Whether the geo (Decodo) render path was used.

screenshotUrl.description: Signed URL of the captured screenshot (short-lived).

extractedText.description: Text a text-watch would compare (text mode only).

reason.description: Actionable reason when reachable is false (blocked / needs login / HTTP error).

WatchWebhookEvent.description:
Payload POSTed to a watch's `webhookUrl` (Starter+ channel) when a monitored page changes
(`watch.changed`), recovers after a failing streak (`watch.recovered`), or a check enters
the failed state (`watch.error`). Conceptually documented at https://rendex.dev/docs/webhooks.

**Signing & delivery headers** — the raw body is HMAC-SHA256 signed exactly like a Stripe
webhook: the hex digest of `{timestamp}.{rawBody}` is sent in `x-rendex-signature`, with the
same `{timestamp}` in `x-rendex-timestamp` (recompute and compare to verify). Each delivery
also carries `x-rendex-event` (the event name), `x-rendex-delivery-id` (a UUID that is stable
across the up-to-3 retries — use it for idempotency), and `User-Agent: Rendex-Webhook/1.0`.
Redirects are NOT followed (SSRF defense) — your endpoint must accept the POST directly.

The `watch.changed` webhook payload and the `WatchRun` object (from
`GET /v1/watches/{id}/runs`) share the same change-event field names —
`diffScore`, `diffPixels`, `beforeUrl`, `afterUrl`, `diffOverlayUrl`, and `textDiff`.

event.description:
`watch.changed` = the tracked page differs from its baseline; `watch.recovered` = a run
succeeded after a failing streak; `watch.error` = a run entered the failed state.

watchId.description: The watch this event belongs to

runId.description: The WatchRun that produced this event

status.description: The run's terminal status (e.g. completed | failed)

changed.description: True on watch.changed; absent or false otherwise

diffScore.description: 0..1 fraction of the page that changed (visual/both).

cropUrl.description: Signed image cropped tight to the change ("what changed")

changedRegion.description: Normalized (0..1) union box of the changed regions. Set only when there is a discrete region.

textDiff.description: Present for text/both runs; same shape as WatchRun.textDiff.

summary.description: One-sentence "what changed" summary — a free templated line on every plan, upgraded to a Workers-AI sentence when a Pro+ watch opts in via aiSummary. Null only when there is genuinely nothing to summarize.

x-rendex-quality.description: Capture quality: full, degraded, or best_attempt

x-rendex-truncated.description: true if full-page capture was height-capped

x-rendex-rendering-engine.description: Rendering engine used for the capture

x-rendex-geo-country.description: ISO country code of the geo-targeted location (if geo was used)

error.message: The page took too long to load. Try increasing the timeout or setting bestAttempt=true.
Rate limit exceeded. Please try again later.
Screenshot capture failed. Please try again or adjust your parameters.

tags.name: Watch
tags.description:
Website change monitoring — create watches, read run history, receive change webhooks.
Rendex renders each check in real Chrome, runs a before/after visual (and/or text) diff,
and alerts you by email (every plan) or signed webhook (Starter+). Shares your `rdx_`
key and credit pool with the rendering endpoints — one credit per check.
